sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तस्य जलक्लिन्नेन पाणिना ।सुग्रीवस्य शुभे नेत्रे प्रममार्ज विभिषणः ।। ६.४६.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tatastasya jalaklinnena pāṇinā ।sugrīvasya śubhe netre pramamārja vibhiṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.46.35 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the dutiful Vibheeshana taking water as per tradition consecrated chanting sacred text and wiped Sugriva's eyes.
